# ApneTailor

> ApneTailor is a technology-enabled tailoring platform connecting customers with nearby verified tailors for custom stitching with doorstep pickup and delivery, progress visibility, and transparent pricing.

Chahiye darji? Done ji.

## Canonical

- Website: https://apnetailor.com

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://apnetailor.com/): Primary entry point and app download CTA
- [How It Works](https://apnetailor.com/how-it-works/): Customer stitching workflow
- [Services](https://apnetailor.com/services/): Supported garment categories
- [Women's Tailoring](https://apnetailor.com/services/women/): Women's garment hub
- [Men's Tailoring](https://apnetailor.com/services/men/): Men's garment hub
- [About](https://apnetailor.com/about/): Company and founders
- [FAQ](https://apnetailor.com/faq/): Common customer questions
- [Support](https://apnetailor.com/support/): Customer support
- [Contact](https://apnetailor.com/contact/): Contact information

## Supported garments

Women: Suit, Saree, Kurti, Lehenga, Blouse
Men: Kurta, Formal Suit, Shirt, Sherwani, Pant

Alterations are not currently offered.
